| [`ai-api-and-tooling`](skills/ai-api-and-tooling/SKILL.md) | draft | Deliver, Assure, Improve | Designs the APIs and shared tooling that custom AI solutions call or expose - contract-first interfaces, narrow tool surfaces a model can use correctly, input validation, user-scoped authorisation, idempotent writes, rate limits, versioning and errors a model can act on. Use when building a service an agent will call as a tool, when exposing an AI capability as an API, or when shared tool libraries are needed across solutions. |
| [`ai-ci-cd`](skills/ai-ci-cd/SKILL.md) | draft | Deliver, Assure, Launch, Improve | Designs CI/CD pipelines for custom AI solutions that build, test, evaluate and deploy code, prompts, model configuration, tools and infrastructure together, with evaluation and safety gates, environment promotion, approvals, model version upgrades and rollback. Use when a pro-code AI solution needs a release pipeline, when prompts or models change outside the pipeline, or when a model version is being retired. |
| [`ai-engineering-standards`](skills/ai-engineering-standards/SKILL.md) | draft | Mobilise, Deliver, Assure, Scale, Improve | Sets and maintains engineering standards for custom AI work - minimum practices by risk tier for repositories, identity, tools, testing, evaluation, pipelines, telemetry, performance, resilience and ownership - with a checklist, exception route and review cycle. Use when pro-code AI work starts, when teams build AI solutions inconsistently, or when standards need refreshing after platform change. |
| [`ai-performance-engineering`](skills/ai-performance-engineering/SKILL.md) | draft | Deliver, Assure, Scale, Improve | Engineers the latency and throughput of custom AI solutions against agreed targets - latency budgets per step, token budgets, streaming, caching, parallel calls, right-sized models, quota and capacity planning, and load testing - while protecting quality and cost. Use when an AI solution is too slow, when usage is about to grow, when throttling appears under load, or before a tier 3 solution goes to production. |
| [`ai-resilience`](skills/ai-resilience/SKILL.md) | draft | Deliver, Assure, Improve | Engineers resilience into custom AI solutions - timeouts, bounded retries, circuit breakers, evaluated fallback deployments or models, degraded modes, content filter and malformed output handling, idempotent tools - so they fail safely and honestly. Use when building a pro-code AI solution, after an outage or throttling incident, or when nothing defines what happens if the model is unavailable. |

Use when starting a pro-code AI solution, when prompts live outside source control, or when a team needs a standard repository template for Foundry or Azure AI work. |
| [`ai-solution-testing`](skills/ai-solution-testing/SKILL.md) | draft | Deliver, Assure, Improve | Sets the testing strategy for pro-code AI solutions - unit tests around non-model code, contract tests for tools, recorded or stubbed model responses, integration, adversarial and failure-path tests - and how each layer fits alongside evaluation. Use when planning tests for a Foundry or Azure AI solution, when tests are flaky because they call live models, or when testing stops at a few manual prompts. |
| [`ai-telemetry`](skills/ai-telemetry/SKILL.md) | draft | Deliver, Assure, Launch, Improve | Designs the telemetry a custom AI solution emits - traces across orchestration, model, retrieval and tool calls, versions, tokens, latency, safety and quality signals and correlation ids - and decides what prompt and response content is captured, redacted and kept. Use when an AI solution needs repeatable evaluation in its pipeline, when manual spot checks no longer scale, or when evaluation results cannot be reproduced. |
